thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High GPU pool pressure detected in us-west-2 (gpu-pool-usw2). Evictions rising, queue length > 1200. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/gpu-pool-usw2 :rotating_light:
oncall-alex: acked. joining bridge.
priya_sre: i'm on the bridge. initial look: autoscaler is oscillating between 24 -> 12 nodes, eviction spikes correspond to node preemptions.
sam_eng: adding: runtime KV cache hit rate dropped to 42% during spike (normal ~88%). likely caused by model-version churn + eviction.
david_infra: checking cloud adapter. I see repeated host preemptions 03:04-03:12 UTC, infra reported spot reclaim for 6 instances. requesting immediate add of 8 on-demand for resilient pool.
oncall-alex: doing soft-shift: enabling regional fallback policy for gen-heavy routes to eu-west-1 for traffic tagged non-latency-critical. will not affect premium customers.
priya_sre: mitigation step 1: disable aggressive downscale window to stop thrash (set scale-down-delay=15m). step 2: drain suspect hosts gracefully.
sam_eng: rolling a small change to model-pin config to avoid cross-variant pulls that bust KV cache: `service.config.model_variant_pinning = true` (pushed to staging).
leah_support: customer impact check: support notes 6 customer reports for timeouts on big-gen endpoints (>=8s). CS flagged two customers in fintech sandbox; both hit error 502 intermittently.
maria_product: queued in product for impact review. any SLA hits?
priya_sre: short answer: internal latency SLOs degraded for non-dedicated hosted tier. no contractual SLA breaches observed yet, but error rate peaked at 11% on large-gen routes for ~22 minutes.
david_infra: on-demand nodes requested, should spin up in ~4-6min. also verifying autostop policies to avoid capacity deficit during night window.
oncall-alex: temporary routing update: 30% of gen traffic shifted to dedicated-reserved pool for customers with capacity. will revert when stable.
sam_eng: note: KV cache warming will take ~10 minutes after traffic shift, expect token cost to normalize.
leah_support: logging: customers who reported timeouts: CUST-4132, CUST-8801. I've opened support tickets and set priority P1 for one with active user sessions.
priya_sre: creating post-incident doc and ops checklist. need volunteers for postmortem: I can lead the timeline + mitigation section. sam can own runtime changes, david for infra action items, leah for customer comms.
maria_product: please schedule 1h postmortem in calendar tomorrow 09:30 PT. include service, infra, support.
noncall-alex: creating Jira: RW-INC-6791 with short description `us-west-2 gpu pool thrash -> customer timeouts`. assigning priya_sre as owner.
priya_sre: action items list (w/ owners):
- A1: Stabilize autoscaler config (priya_sre)
- A2: Provision on-demand fallback pool and run soak test (david_infra)
- A3: Model-pin rollout and KV cache warmup procedure (sam_eng)
- A4: Customer impact follow-ups and status emails (leah_support)
- A5: Add telemetry for preemptions -> eviction correlation (priya_sre + david_infra)

priya_sre: ETA for A1/A5: 24h for config + alerting changes. A2 ETA: 6h to provision + 24h soak. A3 ETA: 12h to roll to hosted, monitor.
leah_support: I will draft customer note template and post to CUST-4132 and CUST-8801 once we have final timeline.
sam_eng: quick snippet to reproduce the spike locally (for postmortem runbook):
```
# simulate eviction churn
for i in {1..30}; do stress --cpu 8 --timeout 60 &; sleep 2; done
```
priya_sre: good. please attach any logs to RW-INC-6791. include `/var/log/runtime/evictions.log` slices between 03:00-03:30 UTC.
david_infra: infra note: we need to review spot allocation mix in us-west-2 and consider moving critical pools to mixed-instance policy. added to RW-INC-6791 as infra-decision item.
oncall-alex: bridging summary: regional fallback + on-demand nodes + autoscaler dampening applied. queue length trending down: 1200 -> 320 in 18m. eviction rate falling.
leah_support: update for CS: telling customers we mitigated and investigating root cause, promise follow-up with timeline.
maria_product: confirm postmortem scheduled. invitees: SRE, Infra, Runtime, Support, Product.
priya_sre: assigning owners into Jira and adding checklist. will run full RCA and share draft 48h.
oncall-alex: last note: please ping thread when A2 is provisioned and when KV hit-rate back above 80%.
priya_sre: will do. closing bridge in 5m but keeping thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
